panels.title: Awaiting approval now
panels.description: Proposed fixes waiting for a human decision.

targets.rawSql:
WITH incident_outcomes AS (
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        i.id AS incident_id,
        i.job_name,
        i.status,
        i.remediation_attempt AS attempt,
        i.created_at AS opened_at,
        (SELECT a.payload ->> 'verdict' FROM audit_events a
          WHERE a.incident_id = i.id AND a.event_type = 'synthesis_completed'
          ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS verdict,
        (SELECT a.payload ->> 'decision' FROM audit_events a
          WHERE a.incident_id = i.id AND a.event_type = 'approval_decided'
          ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS decision,
        (SELECT a.payload ->> 'reviewer' FROM audit_events a
          WHERE a.incident_id = i.id AND a.event_type = 'approval_decided'
          ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS approver,
        (SELECT count(*) FROM audit_events a
          WHERE a.incident_id = i.id AND a.event_type = 'revalidation_completed') AS revalidations,
        (SELECT max(a.created_at) FROM audit_events a
          WHERE a.incident_id = i.id AND a.event_type = 'incident_status_changed'
            AND (a.payload ->> 'to') IN ('RESOLVED', 'ESCALATED', 'CLOSED_REJECTED')) AS status_closed_at,
        (SELECT max(a.created_at) FROM audit_events a
          WHERE a.incident_id = i.id AND a.event_type = 'revalidation_completed' AND a.ok) AS last_passed_at,
        EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM remediation_proposals p
                 WHERE p.incident_id = i.id AND p.status = 'awaiting_approval'
                   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM approvals ap WHERE ap.incident_id = p.incident_id AND ap.attempt = p.attempt)) AS awaiting,
        EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM remediation_proposals p
                 WHERE p.incident_id = i.id AND p.status = 'policy_rejected') AS policy_blocked
    FROM incidents i
)
SELECT
    incident_id,
    job_name,
    status,
    attempt,
    opened_at,
    verdict,
    decision,
    approver,
    revalidations,
    CASE
        WHEN status = 'RESOLVED' THEN 'resolved_by_fix'
        WHEN status = 'ESCALATED' THEN 'escalated'
        WHEN status = 'CLOSED_REJECTED' THEN 'rejected'
        WHEN decision = 'rejected' THEN 'rejected'
        WHEN decision = 'approved' THEN 'awaiting_validation'
        WHEN awaiting THEN 'awaiting_approval'
        WHEN policy_blocked THEN 'policy_blocked'
        ELSE 'open'
    END AS outcome,
    CASE
        WHEN status IN ('RESOLVED', 'ESCALATED', 'CLOSED_REJECTED') THEN COALESCE(status_closed_at, last_passed_at)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS closed_at
FROM base
)
SELECT count(*) AS waiting FROM incident_outcomes WHERE outcome = 'awaiting_approval' AND incident_id IN (SELECT i.id FROM incidents i WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY[$job]::text[]) AS p(job) WHERE i.job_name = p.job OR left(i.job_name, length(p.job) + 1) = p.job || '/'))

panels.title: Oldest waiting (minutes)
panels.description: Age of the longest-waiting proposal. Empty when nothing is waiting.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round((extract(epoch FROM (now() - min(p.created_at))) / 60)::numeric, 0) AS minutes FROM remediation_proposals p WHERE p.status = 'awaiting_approval' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM approvals ap WHERE ap.incident_id = p.incident_id AND ap.attempt = p.attempt) AND p.incident_id IN (SELECT i.id FROM incidents i WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY[$job]::text[]) AS p(job) WHERE i.job_name = p.job OR left(i.job_name, length(p.job) + 1) = p.job || '/'))

panels.title: Approval latency
panels.description: Minutes from a fix being put in front of a reviewer to their decision.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS decisions, round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM (d.created_at - r.created_at))) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS p50_min, round((percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM (d.created_at - r.created_at))) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS p95_min FROM audit_events d JOIN audit_events r ON r.incident_id = d.incident_id AND r.event_type = 'approval_requested' WHERE d.event_type = 'approval_decided' AND d.created_at >= r.created_at AND d.incident_id IN (SELECT i.id FROM incidents i WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY[$job]::text[]) AS p(job) WHERE i.job_name = p.job OR left(i.job_name, length(p.job) + 1) = p.job || '/')) AND $__timeFilter(d.created_at)

panels.title: Agent failures and timeouts over time
panels.description: failed, timed_out and not_dispatched agent runs.

targets.rawSql:
WITH agent_runs AS (
WITH ev AS (
    SELECT
        id, incident_id, actor, event_type, created_at, duration_ms, ok, payload,
        lag(event_type) OVER w AS prev_type,
        lag(created_at) OVER w AS prev_at,
        lead(event_type) OVER w AS next_type
    FROM audit_events
    WHERE event_type IN ('agent_started', 'agent_completed', 'agent_failed')
    WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY incident_id, actor ORDER BY created_at, id)
),
finished AS (
    SELECT
        incident_id,
        actor AS agent,
        prev_at AS started_at,
        created_at AS finished_at,
        COALESCE(payload ->> 'status', CASE WHEN event_type = 'agent_failed' THEN 'failed' ELSE 'completed' END) AS status,
        payload ->> 'failure_type' AS failure_type,
        CAST(payload ->> 'confidence' AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS confidence,
        duration_ms,
        ok,
        'run' AS source
    FROM ev
    WHERE event_type IN ('agent_completed', 'agent_failed') AND prev_type = 'agent_started'
),
unfinished AS (
    SELECT
        incident_id,
        actor AS agent,
        created_at AS started_at,
        CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) AS finished_at,
        'running' AS status,
        CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS failure_type,
        CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS confidence,
        CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS duration_ms,
        CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS ok,
        'run' AS source
    FROM ev
    WHERE event_type = 'agent_started' AND (next_type IS NULL OR next_type = 'agent_started')
),
dispatched AS (
    SELECT
        d.incident_id,
        d.payload ->> 'agent' AS agent,
        CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) AS started_at,
        d.created_at AS finished_at,
        d.payload ->> 'outcome' AS status,
        CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS failure_type,
        CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS confidence,
        d.duration_ms,
        d.ok,
        'dispatch' AS source
    FROM audit_events d
    WHERE d.event_type = 'agent_dispatch'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM audit_events r
          WHERE r.incident_id = d.incident_id
            AND r.actor = d.payload ->> 'agent'
            AND r.event_type = 'agent_started'
      )
)
SELECT * FROM finished
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM unfinished
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM dispatched
)
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(finished_at, $__interval), status AS metric, count(*) AS runs FROM agent_runs WHERE status IN ('failed', 'timed_out', 'not_dispatched') AND incident_id IN (SELECT i.id FROM incidents i WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY[$job]::text[]) AS p(job) WHERE i.job_name = p.job OR left(i.job_name, length(p.job) + 1) = p.job || '/')) AND $__timeFilter(finished_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Re-validation pass rate
panels.description: Share of Jenkins re-validations that passed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval), round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN ok THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 1) AS pass_rate FROM audit_events WHERE event_type = 'revalidation_completed' AND incident_id IN (SELECT i.id FROM incidents i WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY[$job]::text[]) AS p(job) WHERE i.job_name = p.job OR left(i.job_name, length(p.job) + 1) = p.job || '/')) AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Re-validations per incident
panels.description: How many fix attempts incidents needed before they ended.

targets.rawSql:
WITH incident_outcomes AS (
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        i.id AS incident_id,
        i.job_name,
        i.status,
        i.remediation_attempt AS attempt,
        i.created_at AS opened_at,
        (SELECT a.payload ->> 'verdict' FROM audit_events a
          WHERE a.incident_id = i.id AND a.event_type = 'synthesis_completed'
          ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS verdict,
        (SELECT a.payload ->> 'decision' FROM audit_events a
          WHERE a.incident_id = i.id AND a.event_type = 'approval_decided'
          ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS decision,
        (SELECT a.payload ->> 'reviewer' FROM audit_events a
          WHERE a.incident_id = i.id AND a.event_type = 'approval_decided'
          ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS approver,
        (SELECT count(*) FROM audit_events a
          WHERE a.incident_id = i.id AND a.event_type = 'revalidation_completed') AS revalidations,
        (SELECT max(a.created_at) FROM audit_events a
          WHERE a.incident_id = i.id AND a.event_type = 'incident_status_changed'
            AND (a.payload ->> 'to') IN ('RESOLVED', 'ESCALATED', 'CLOSED_REJECTED')) AS status_closed_at,
        (SELECT max(a.created_at) FROM audit_events a
          WHERE a.incident_id = i.id AND a.event_type = 'revalidation_completed' AND a.ok) AS last_passed_at,
        EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM remediation_proposals p
                 WHERE p.incident_id = i.id AND p.status = 'awaiting_approval'
                   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM approvals ap WHERE ap.incident_id = p.incident_id AND ap.attempt = p.attempt)) AS awaiting,
        EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM remediation_proposals p
                 WHERE p.incident_id = i.id AND p.status = 'policy_rejected') AS policy_blocked
    FROM incidents i
)
SELECT
    incident_id,
    job_name,
    status,
    attempt,
    opened_at,
    verdict,
    decision,
    approver,
    revalidations,
    CASE
        WHEN status = 'RESOLVED' THEN 'resolved_by_fix'
        WHEN status = 'ESCALATED' THEN 'escalated'
        WHEN status = 'CLOSED_REJECTED' THEN 'rejected'
        WHEN decision = 'rejected' THEN 'rejected'
        WHEN decision = 'approved' THEN 'awaiting_validation'
        WHEN awaiting THEN 'awaiting_approval'
        WHEN policy_blocked THEN 'policy_blocked'
        ELSE 'open'
    END AS outcome,
    CASE
        WHEN status IN ('RESOLVED', 'ESCALATED', 'CLOSED_REJECTED') THEN COALESCE(status_closed_at, last_passed_at)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS closed_at
FROM base
)
SELECT revalidations::text AS revalidations, count(*) AS incidents FROM incident_outcomes WHERE revalidations > 0 AND incident_id IN (SELECT i.id FROM incidents i WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY[$job]::text[]) AS p(job) WHERE i.job_name = p.job OR left(i.job_name, length(p.job) + 1) = p.job || '/')) AND $__timeFilter(opened_at) GROUP BY revalidations ORDER BY revalidations

panels.title: Policy denial reasons
panels.description: Why policy refused proposals, most common first.

targets.rawSql: SELECT left(coalesce(payload->>'violations', payload->>'package', 'unspecified'), 80) AS reason, count(*) AS denials FROM audit_events WHERE event_type = 'policy_evaluated' AND (payload->>'allowed') = 'false' AND incident_id IN (SELECT i.id FROM incidents i WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY[$job]::text[]) AS p(job) WHERE i.job_name = p.job OR left(i.job_name, length(p.job) + 1) = p.job || '/')) AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Time between steps (median, min)
panels.description: Median minutes from approval to the pull request, and from the pull request to Jenkins re-validation. Empty until pull requests are audited.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS incidents, round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM (pr - decided))) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS approval_to_pr, round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM (revalidated - pr))) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS pr_to_revalidation FROM (SELECT incident_id, min(created_at) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'approval_decided' AND ok) AS decided, min(created_at) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'pull_request_created') AS pr, min(created_at) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'revalidation_completed') AS revalidated FROM audit_events WHERE incident_id IN (SELECT i.id FROM incidents i WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY[$job]::text[]) AS p(job) WHERE i.job_name = p.job OR left(i.job_name, length(p.job) + 1) = p.job || '/')) AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY incident_id) steps

SELECT opened_at AS "time", incident_id, job_name, outcome, verdict, approver, closed_at FROM incident_outcomes WHERE outcome IN ('escalated', 'rejected') AND incident_id IN (SELECT i.id FROM incidents i WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY[$job]::text[]) AS p(job) WHERE i.job_name = p.job OR left(i.job_name, length(p.job) + 1) = p.job || '/')) AND $__timeFilter(opened_at) ORDER BY opened_at DESC LIMIT 20
